preregistration.operator: Parent reviewed source, protocol and provider-free gates; --freeze --reviewed

privacy.redaction_boundary: All trial prompts, provider receipts, databases, IDs and host paths are withheld-private pending exact-byte review. Never persist key contents in configs or metadata; actual charges stay unknown.

comparison.comparator: A typed Astra intent+target helper versus B direct Jev1.13.0 helper; root/cognitive/final Astra subscription xhigh fixed

environment.reset_strategy: Fresh public-network agent and separate static no-network verifier containers per cell; native Harbor artifact transfer only. No operator workspace mounted. Provider-free actual infrastructure proof expires after 24h. Root 540s, Harbor agent 570s, host watchdog 1290s plus cancellation cleanup up to 120s. No trial rerun or helper HTTP retry; identical bounded root retry policy inherited.

study.analysis_plan: Three author-visible inboxes, 12 items each, A/B once; 36 items and 72 intended Choice answers per arm. Distinguish intent, target, full task success, wrong/extra reads, false completion, rejudgments and per-purpose costs. Preselected replay: inbox-korean, repetition0. Final/cognitive/root Astra subscription xhigh remain common; raw rule_based alias resolves to effective llm_judge. No pooling with historical runs. New recovery condition: shared root budget 540s; Harbor agent 570s; host watchdog 1290s, with the previous workload, model, effort, round and continuation limits unchanged. Operational allocation only, not an empirical SLO; retain prior interrupted lineage separately. Authorized new540s policy epoch (initial and at most two verification continuations share one clock); not pooled with180s results. Jev program cap2.35/start2.115/stop2.2325. Budget amendment authorization sha256:0daa4127e765adb51b5ea67de0bc58e6199e1ff0363b70bc8cc7f5e81915d4ff. No claim of empirical optimality or guaranteed completion.
study.decision_rule: Diagnostic only. Freeze after parent review; then both fresh admission arms and playback must pass before natural execution. No adoption or release authority.
study.hypothesis: Jev may reduce helper latency while whole-task success and total burden depend on the unchanged Astra consumer.
study.invalidation_rule: Stop on incomplete exports, observation/checker/source/usage/credential failure or timeout. Preserve invalid trials as unknown; any missing/invalid planned cell makes primary not measurable. Valid semantic failures continue.

primary_metric.aggregation: (B strict inbox passes - A strict inbox passes) / 3. Strict: native/oracle pass with consumed evidence and zero wrong-target/extra lookups or false completions.
primary_metric.name: strict_task_success_delta

study.research_gap: Component decisions alone do not establish downstream task completion, recovery, or full task burden.
study.research_question: Does replacing a typed Astra intent-and-target helper with Jev preserve verified whole-inbox completion and change end-to-end burden?
